title: Resolution urging Albany to fully exempt some seniors from property tax
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation letting New York City give a full property tax exemption to homeowners who qualify for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption and whose only income is Social Security. Currently even seniors who qualify for the maximum SCHE benefit still pay 50 percent of their property taxes. The Council notes that many older homeowners on fixed incomes struggle to keep up with rising property taxes despite having built up home equity.
